sentences.en: Please find attached the VAT invoice for your recent purchase.
sentences.zh: 请查收附件中的增值税发票，这是您最近购买商品的发票。

sentences.en: We paid an invoice of more than one thousand dollars.
sentences.zh: 我们支付了一张超过一千美元的账单。

sentences.en: They told me there was a problem with the invoice.
sentences.zh: 他们告诉我发票存在问题。
